pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay

return_outlier.note: VBI entry before Decode; subsequent IRQ observations show kernel DP 0x0A00, then selected restores worker DP 0x1100. Native-body subtraction leaves scheduling/return work charged to the worker. Deliver itself only decodes and enqueues a byte; it does not signal another Task.

notes: IR5 adds host-side observations only. Raw/optimized production and diagnostic correctness and consumer race coverage remain in IR1-IR4.
Service percentages use only the matched phase-zero profile. Other phases have final service costs and matched CB4 visible latency, not an invented service baseline.
The 2 ms service target fails Return in phase zero; 4 ms worker and 40 ms visible input remain unmet. Loaded launch-to-idle bounds exceed 20 ms; isolated scrolling was not remeasured.
All phases use the same final XEX. Replay may overwrite local generated harness/state files; recorded observer hashes are verified by relocating the saved baseline script.
Physical input schedule and draw/drain budgets are unchanged. Workload progress determines total rows (33-34 vs CB4 35); no equal-work aggregate CPU claim.
C operation costs cover keyboard EMPTY/Pending and pointer initial event/Pending plus rejected calls, with no before/after baseline.
Full-ring pump budget remains 64; the global Forbid measurement is not a full-ring input-only benchmark. Budget/queue-capacity decoupling remains a separate follow-up.
Unrelated cartridge changes and demo/release artifacts are outside this slice.
